text: Install a parser fuse that rejects excessive nesting and integer digit bombs before semantic loading.
rationale: Prevents RecursionError and huge-int failures at the JSON boundary.

text: Route diagnostics through an ASCII-safe incident envelope while preserving normal UTF-8 output.
rationale: Stops surrogate-containing paths or messages from crashing error reporting.

text: Preflight byte ceilings and decode inputs incrementally into bounded buffers.
rationale: Makes manifest and receipt caps enforceable before parser work begins.

text: Represent malformed inputs as typed quarantine records carrying only path, stage, and exception class.
rationale: Keeps failures actionable without leaking receipt content.

text: Add a final non-throwing renderer for stdout and stderr that substitutes unencodable characters.
rationale: Ensures reporting remains reliable when output encoding rejects data.

text: Separate lexical JSON safety checks from business aggregation so rejected files cannot perturb valid totals.
rationale: Contains parser failures while preserving independent acceptance semantics.
